headline: Nova Energy switches on its first tidal power unit
summary: The unit sits off a quiet stretch of coast. It can power about 9,000 homes.

headline: Nova Energy says summer demand beat its own forecast
summary: Hot weeks pushed grid use higher than planned. The company added two extra supply deals.

headline: Nova Energy signs a 10-year deal with three city grids
summary: The deal locks in a fixed price until 2036. Both sides can review it after five years.

headline: Nova Energy pauses work on its northern wind farm
summary: A soil survey came back with bad news. Work stops until a new site plan is ready.

headline: Nova Energy cuts home electricity prices by 4%
summary: The cut starts next month for all home plans. Business plans stay the same for now.

headline: Nova Energy names a new head of grid safety
summary: The role was empty for six months. The new head starts in two weeks.

headline: Kryl Robotics shows an arm that packs fragile fruit
summary: The arm handles soft fruit without bruising it. Three packing sheds are testing it now.

headline: Kryl Robotics wins a large warehouse order
summary: The order covers 400 units over two years. It is the biggest single order Kryl has taken.

headline: Kryl Robotics delays its small home robot again
summary: Battery tests did not go well. The launch moves to late next year.

headline: Kryl Robotics opens a repair hub for older machines
summary: Owners can now get parts for machines up to ten years old. Repairs take about a week.

headline: Kryl Robotics drops the price of its starter arm
summary: The starter arm now costs a third less. Kryl says smaller workshops asked for it.

headline: Kryl Robotics loses two engineers to a rival maker
summary: Both led work on the gripper team. Kryl says the work carries on as planned.

headline: Brisk Foods pulls one soup batch over a label mix-up
summary: The label missed a nut warning. No one has reported being unwell.

headline: Brisk Foods opens a second bakery line
summary: The new line doubles bread output. It took eight months to build.

headline: Brisk Foods puts its frozen meals in 300 more shops
summary: The range goes on sale this week. Prices stay the same across all shops.

headline: Brisk Foods says cocoa costs are eating into profit
summary: Cocoa prices rose for a third straight season. Brisk may change some recipes.

headline: Brisk Foods brings back its old biscuit recipe
summary: Shoppers asked for it for years. The old recipe returns in a limited run.

headline: Brisk Foods cuts sugar in its breakfast range
summary: Each pack now has about a fifth less sugar. The taste tests passed in May.

headline: Luma Health opens three new day clinics
summary: Each clinic runs six days a week. Waiting times should drop by about a third.

headline: Luma Health home test kit passes its final check
summary: The kit can now be sold without a prescription. It ships to pharmacies next month.

headline: Luma Health hires 200 nurses for its night service
summary: The night service covers four regions. Hiring finishes before winter.

headline: Luma Health pauses one trial after slow sign-ups
summary: Only a third of the places were filled. The trial restarts once the rules are simpler.

headline: Luma Health ties up with a small scanner maker
summary: The deal gives Luma cheaper scanners for its clinics. Delivery starts in spring.

headline: Luma Health drops the fee for its follow-up calls
summary: Follow-up calls are now free for every patient. The change starts next month.

headline: Oak Finance opens savings accounts to under-18s
summary: A parent still has to sign the form. The account pays the same rate as an adult one.

headline: Oak Finance says late payments fell for a third quarter
summary: Fewer customers missed a payment this quarter. Oak put it down to simpler reminders.

headline: Oak Finance closes 12 small branches
summary: All 12 branches had fewer than 20 visits a day. Staff move to nearby offices.

headline: Oak Finance raises its savings rate to 4.1%
summary: The new rate starts on Monday. It applies to every easy-access account.

headline: Oak Finance app goes down for two hours
summary: A failed update took the app offline. Card payments kept working throughout.

headline: Oak Finance offers free transfers to new businesses
summary: Transfers are free for the first year. After that the normal fee returns.

headline: Pixel Games delays its farm game to next spring
summary: The team wants more time on the co-op mode. Pre-orders stay open.

headline: Pixel Games hits 10 million players on its puzzle app
summary: The app passed the mark on Tuesday. It took 14 months to get there.

headline: Pixel Games turns off ads in its games for children
summary: All six of those games lose their ads. Pixel will charge a one-off price instead.

headline: Pixel Games buys a small studio of 12 people
summary: The studio built two racing games. Both teams will share one engine.

headline: Pixel Games patches a save bug in its racing title
summary: The bug wiped progress on long races. Saves made before the patch can be restored.

headline: Pixel Games says its next title will skip early access
summary: The team wants to ship a finished game. The release date comes in autumn.

headline: Terra Farms finishes its biggest grain harvest yet
summary: The harvest came in a week early. Dry weather helped more than expected.

headline: Terra Farms tests a seed that needs less water
summary: Trials run on 400 hectares this season. Results are due after the summer.

headline: Terra Farms loses part of its apple crop to late frost
summary: About a fifth of the crop was hit. Other orchards came through fine.

headline: Terra Farms sells its oldest dairy site
summary: The site had been running for 40 years. The money goes into new grain stores.

headline: Terra Farms starts selling direct to shoppers online
summary: Boxes ship twice a week. Delivery covers most of the country.

headline: Terra Farms signs a supply deal with a bakery chain
summary: The chain takes a quarter of the Terra flour crop. The deal runs for three years.

headline: Velo Bikes recalls 4,000 bikes over a brake part
summary: One batch of brake levers can crack. Owners get a free replacement.

headline: Velo Bikes opens a flagship shop in the old market hall
summary: The shop has a repair bench and a test track. It opens on Saturday.

headline: Velo Bikes says cargo bike sales doubled this year
summary: Small businesses bought most of them. Velo is adding a second cargo model.

headline: Velo Bikes drops its heaviest commuter model
summary: The model sold poorly for two years. Spare parts stay available until 2032.

headline: Velo Bikes puts a five-year warranty on every frame
summary: The warranty covers cracks and welds. It applies to bikes sold from today.

headline: Velo Bikes moves its wheel building back in-house
summary: Wheels were made by an outside workshop. The change adds 30 jobs.

headline: Market closes higher as energy and food stocks climb
summary: Six of the eight listed stocks ended the day up. Trading was heavier than usual.

headline: Quiet trading day as most stocks drift sideways
summary: Few stocks moved more than 1%. Volumes were the lowest this month.

headline: Robotics and games stocks lead an early rally
summary: Both sectors opened strong and held the gain. The rest followed by midday.

headline: Market slips after a weak start to the week
summary: Most stocks gave back the gains of last week. Finance held up best.

headline: Trading volumes jump to a three-month high
summary: More small orders drove the rise. Prices themselves barely moved.

headline: Food and farm stocks steady after a bumpy week
summary: Both sectors ended close to where they started. Traders called it a pause.

headline: Analysts expect a calmer month ahead
summary: Price swings have narrowed for three weeks. Nothing big is due on the calendar.

headline: Health stocks give back some of their monthly gain
summary: The sector is still ahead over the year. Most of the drop came in one session.

headline: Market opens flat before a busy week of updates
summary: Four companies report in the next five days. Traders are waiting it out.

headline: Small orders now make up most of the daily trades
summary: The average order size fell again. The pattern has held since spring.

headline: Energy leads the market for a second week
summary: Energy is the best sector of the month so far. Finance sits in second place.

headline: Market ends the month where it began
summary: Gains and losses cancelled out over four weeks. Two sectors did most of the moving.
